ICE Arrests: Minnesota After January 20, 2025

Detention itineraries, transfer flows, and removal outcomes

Published

May 24, 2026

This report traces ICE arrests made in Minnesota on or after January 20, 2025 through the full detention and removal pipeline, using individual-level FOIA data from the Deportation Data Project.

5,768 arrests · 5,545 distinct individuals · 5,655 detention stays · 61.5% ultimately removed

Data notes

  • Source: Deportation Data Project, FOIA 2026-ICLI-00005.
  • Filtered to apprehension_state == "MINNESOTA" and apprehension_date >= 2025-01-20. Duplicate-flagged rows excluded.
  • Stays linked via unique_identifier; only stays beginning on or after 2025-01-20 are included.
  • Transfer flows show consecutive facility pairs from detention_facility_codes_all; min threshold = 5 transfers.
  • County choropleth coverage: 90% of arrests mapped to a county.
  • stay_release_reason is NA for stays open as of March 2026 (shown as “Pending / Unknown”).
  • EROFCB = ERO El Paso Camp East Montana (militarized facility in Montana operated by El Paso ERO).
